standard.summary: Prior preservation 需要生成/使用的类别图像张数。默认 100。
standard.effect: 自动生成路径触发时（prior_loss_weight>0、reg_data_dir 为空、class_prompt 非空），用底模生成这么多张类别图作为正则集。
standard.whenToUse: 实例图较多或训练步数较长时适当增加（150~300），让正则集多样性跟上；快速实验可减到 50。
standard.avoidWhen: 提供了 reg_data_dir 时本值不参与；数量太大生成耗时线性增长且收益边际递减。

standard_en.summary: How many class images prior preservation needs to generate or use. Default 100.
standard_en.effect: When the automatic generation path triggers (prior_loss_weight>0, reg_data_dir empty, class_prompt non-empty), the base model generates this many class images as the regularisation set.
standard_en.whenToUse: Raise it (150~300) when there are many instance images or the run is long, so the regularisation set keeps up in variety; drop it to 50 for a quick experiment.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It plays no part once reg_data_dir is provided; a very large count costs linearly more generation time with diminishing returns.

advanced.principle: 正则集的作用是采样类别先验分布；数量太少时先验估计噪声大、单张正则图被重复看到导致过拟合到这些生成样本，经验上正则图数量 ≈ 实例图 × 10 或至少覆盖训练步数的正则采样需求。
advanced.intervention: dreambooth_prior_setup.py：num_class = int(config.num_class_images or 100)，传入 ClassImageGenerator 逐张生成到 class_images 目录（已存在的图会复用）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 更大的正则集让先验保持更平滑；生成阶段耗时与数量成正比。
advanced.tradeoffs: 生成图占磁盘（每张几百 KB 到几 MB）；底模生成质量差时数量再多也帮助有限。

advanced_en.principle: The regularization set's role is sampling the class prior distribution; too few images make the prior estimate noisy, and seeing the same regularization images repeatedly overfits to those generated samples. Empirically, regularization images ≈ instance images × 10, or at least enough to cover the regularization sampling demand over the training steps.
advanced_en.intervention: dreambooth_prior_setup.py: num_class = int(config.num_class_images or 100), passed into ClassImageGenerator to generate image by image into the class_images directory (existing images are reused).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: A larger regularization set makes prior preservation smoother; generation time scales with count.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Generated images occupy disk (hundreds of KB to a few MB each); when base-model generation quality is poor, more images help little.
advanced_en.codePath: dreambooth_prior_setup.py: num_class resolution and generation loop; dreambooth.py:ClassImageGenerator.generate
